title: Boolean block expectation formula
statement:
Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and let $F$ be a continuous complex-valued function on the torus indexed by $(\mathrm{Fin}\,n\times\{0,1\})\sqcup(\mathrm{Fin}\,n\times\{0,1\})$. The Boolean block expectation of $F$ is
\[
2^{-nm}\sum_{x,y\in\{0,1\}^{nm}}K_\rho(x,y)\,F\bigl(G(x,y)\bigr),
\]
where $K_\rho$ is the noise kernel and $G(x,y)$ is the pair of torus images obtained from the normalized blocks of $x$ and $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is continuous and complex-valued on the specified torus
